scopeReview: PSO-7.A.5–7: restructuring, outsourcing/offshoring, production zones, international division of labor, post-Fordism, scale/agglomeration, just-in-time, multiplier effects and high-tech growth poles.
varietyReview: Four assessed original stimuli: sector job chart, average-cost account, design/assembly network and inventory interruption. Additional applications distinguish organizational/geographic changes and local spillover conditions.
repetitionReview: Avoids equating job decline with output decline, outsourcing with offshoring, internal scale with external proximity or any zone with guaranteed local gains. Inventory assumptions explicit; varied keys and detailed options. Difficulty uncalibrated.
referenceNote: Official scope and primary ILO production/task/employment analysis checked. Synthetic accounts and original diagrams only; no actual firm/worker claims, outside lesson import or independent human review.
